topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning objectives and sets out the historical and molecular themes of the session.

topics.label: Viral Oncology and Cellular Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming viruses revealed cellular oncogenes and established laboratory methods to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, Tumor Suppressor Genes, and Mutational Mechanics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics contrast the functional definitions of oncogenes and tumor suppressors, illustrating their mechanisms in cell cycle checkpoints and mutant allele dynamics.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the distinct forms of sequence and chromosomal instability, detailing how defects in DNA repair and mitosis drive progressive tumor evolution.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how germline mutations accelerate cancer development and how tumors evolve under selective pressure.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with reading suggestions and an outlook on the next lecture.
